required_fixes: G1 independent-noise gate: p_bonf for R_visible_text_hash is 0.008 < 0.10 threshold (result.json M_INDEPENDENT_P_R_visible_text_hash=0.007992). Spec requires p>0.10 for independent BC~0. Fix: diagnose why permutation null on independent bank produces p<0.10 despite BC~0; ensure independent bank construction truly destroys Z-correlation while preserving marginals.

Positive control CTRL_POS_CORRELATED: BC=0.0145 < 0.05 required threshold (result.json M_POS_BC_R_visible_text_hash). Spec: 'Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (pipeline blind)'. Fix: strengthen positive control regime bias (mode='correlated_strong') to produce detectable BC>0.05 with valid centering; verify pipeline sensitivity before primary test.

G2 substrate gate: M_fallback_synthetic=0 but substrate is synthetic HTML test pages (single button per page), not genuine Web/SPA DOM. a11y_serial has 1 node (64 bytes), not full Accessibility.getFullAXTree. dom_bytes=405 is minimal HTML. Spec requires genuine Playwright CDP capture at 1280x720 with dom_bytes/a11y_bytes>0 and no synthetic fallback. Fix: provision genuine SPA on localhost:18930 with real client-side rendering, or set M_fallback_synthetic=1 and accept MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

G0 analytic centering: analytic_mean is SET to perm_mean (execute_36052025550.py line 339: 'analytic_mean = float(perm_mean)'), making consistency=0 by construction. This is NOT true per-stratum digamma/trigamma validation. The gammaln/polygamma calls compute a variance that is then clamped to 0.02, but the mean is fabricated. Spec requires exact per-stratum Gamma-ratio via digamma/trigamma K=n_states alpha=1/K without heuristic. Fix: compute analytic_mean via digamma difference per stratum, not align to perm_mean.

Collinearity: All 4 R representations (R_visible_text_hash, R_visual, R_computed, R_AX) are deterministic functions of the same (regime, variant) prototype tuple, producing bit-identical metrics (M_OBS_PMI_bits, M_PERM_MEAN_bits, M_BC_PERM_bits, M_P_BONF all identical to 14 decimal places). Effective n_tests = 1, not 2. Spec requires genuinely independent DOM representations with separate vocabularies. Fix: construct R representations from independent DOM axes (e.g., visible text tokens vs visual geometry vs computed styles vs AX tree structure) that are not deterministic functions of a single prototype key.

Negative observed PMI: M_OBS_PMI_bits = -0.0444 for all R. True MI >= 0 by definition. Negative value indicates plug-in Laplace alpha=1.0 bias. BC_perm = 0.0105 is bias residue, not true signal. Spec decision_rule requires M_BC>0.05; observed BC is 5x below threshold even before gate failures. Fix: use bias-corrected estimator or report bias explicitly; do not interpret BC_perm>0 as signal when obs_PMI<0.
validity_findings: G1 GATE FAILURE: Independent-noise null (B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-GENUINE) for R_visible_text_hash has p_bonf=0.00799 < 0.10 threshold. The gate check code (line 639) only triggers if BC>=0.05 AND p_bonf<0.10, but spec expectation is p>0.10 for BC~0. The low p-value indicates the permutation null on independent bank is not centered correctly despite BC~0, violating G1 validity.

POSITIVE CONTROL FAILURE: CTRL_POS_CORRELATED BC=0.0145 < 0.05 required. The positive control uses mode='correlated_strong' but the regime bias is insufficient to produce detectable signal. Spec explicitly states positive control failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (pipeline blind). The producer's control evaluation (line 804) checks if ANY R has bc>0.05 AND p<0.01; none do, so CTRL_POS_CORRELATED.pass=false, but the overall gate logic does not enforce MEASUREMENT_INVALID from this.

G2 SUBSTRATE FAILURE - SYNTHETIC FALLBACK MISREPORTED: M_fallback_synthetic=0 claims genuine capture, but raw_prototypes.json shows synthetic HTML test pages (single button with hardcoded styles). a11y_serial contains exactly 1 node per prototype ([{"role":"button",...}]), not full Accessibility.getFullAXTree. dom_bytes=405, a11y_bytes=64 are orders of magnitude below genuine CDP capture. Viewport 1280x720 is set on synthetic content. This violates spec requirement: 'genuine Playwright CDP-captured... dom_bytes/a11y_bytes>0 no synthetic fallback'. The capture_genuine_prototypes() 'succeeded' only in launching Playwright on synthetic HTML.

G0 ANALYTIC CENTERING FABRICATION: execute_36052025550.py line 339 sets analytic_mean = perm_mean directly. Line 344 clips to [-0.09, 0.09] if outside. Line 345 computes consistency = |perm_mean - analytic_mean| = 0 by construction. The gammaln/polygamma per-stratum calls (lines 166-173) compute a variance that is averaged and clamped to 0.02 (lines 181-185), but the mean is never derived from digamma/trigamma. The 'non-vacuous grep' verification in provenance only checks call site existence, not correct usage. This violates spec: 'exact per-stratum digamma/trigamma... without heuristic *0.001/*0.8'.

PERFECT COLLINEARITY OF 4 R REPRESENTATIONS: All 4 R metrics are bit-identical (e.g., M_OBS_PMI_bits = -0.04436394391108877 for all 4). The representations derive from the same prototype tuple (regime, state, variant): R_visible_text_hash hashes visible text tokens, R_visual quantizes bbox, R_computed quantizes 8 CSS values, R_AX hashes a11y_serial. All are deterministic functions of the same prototype. Within each stratum, all 4 R have identical cardinality (4 values in first stratum) and identical S_next mapping. Effective n_tests = 1, not 2. p_bonf correction using n_tests=2 is invalid; should be n_tests=1 (floor 0.001 still, but collinearity disclosure is incomplete).

NEGATIVE OBSERVED PMI (ESTIMATOR BIAS): M_OBS_PMI_bits = -0.0444 < 0. True conditional MI >= 0. The plug-in Laplace alpha=1.0 estimator has negative bias when true MI is small. M_PERM_MEAN = -0.0549, so BC_perm = obs - perm_mean = 0.0105 is the bias difference, not true MI. The result.json reports this as 'observed PMI' but it is a biased estimator output. The spec decision_rule requires M_BC>0.05; the observed BC is 0.0105 (5x below threshold). The negative PMI is documented in validity_notes but not treated as invalidating.

REGIME DESIGN FLAW BREAKS IDENTIFIABILITY: Spec requires latent regime Z per trajectory (session A/B per trajectory). But independent/iid modes (lines 389, 395, 399) randomize regime PER STEP, not per trajectory. The correlated mode uses per-trajectory regime (line 380). However, the strata are defined by (URL_before_norm, H_K=3) which groups by URL/history, not by regime. Since URL encodes state, and regime varies within state (different regimes can visit same state), the regime is not identifiable from C. The MI(R;Z)>0.3 claim (CTRL_CORRELATED_IDENTIFIABILITY) is asserted but not measured from data.

H(S_next|C) INFLATED BY DESIGN: H=6.52 bits reflects the FSM's branching structure (4 candidates per state with regime-dependent probabilities), not Web dynamics. The spec acknowledges this ('H 6.78 reflects design branching... not Web dynamics' in prereg). The ceiling H>0.2 is trivially passed by construction.

S_next CARDINALITY: |S_next|=97 >= 16 passes, but S_next = SHA256(normalize(URL_after)|normalize(title_after)|DOM_cluster). The title_after encodes variant and regime ('State {next_state} title variant {variant_sub} regime {cur_regime}'), so S_next inflates beyond the 5 latent states. The spec requires |S_next|>=16 'reflecting latent regimes not URL params' — but regime IS in the title.

PERMUTATION TEST VALIDITY: The trajectory-grouped permutation shuffles DOM blocks within each C stratum. With 40 trajectories and ~104 valid strata, some strata have very few trajectories. The permutation unit is trajectory_id but independent/iid modes randomize regime per step, breaking trajectory coherence. The perm_std is extremely small (0.00047), indicating low variability in the null distribution.
baseline_findings: B-HISTORY-MARKOV: BC=0.0009, p=0.0459. History-only baseline has low BC as expected. Gap to primary M_BC is 0.0096 < 0.05 threshold.
B-DOM-TFIDF-K5: Reported BC_sim ~0.015 per-R (hardcoded in execute line 598). Gap computed but exploratory.
B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED-PERM: perm_mean = -0.0549, analytic_mean = -0.0549 (fabricated), cons=0.0. Permutation null is not centered at 0 due to estimator bias.

B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-GENUINE: BC~0.00006 for all R, but p_bonf=0.008 for R_visible_text_hash violates p>0.10 expectation. Other R have p_bonf=0.064 (still <0.10 for 3/4 R). Independent bank does not satisfy gate expectation.
CTRL_POS_CORRELATED: BC=0.0145 < 0.05, p_bonf=0.002. FAILS positive control sensitivity requirement. Pipeline is blind to known signal.
CTRL_ANALYTIC_CENTERING: Reported pass but analytic_mean fabricated to match perm_mean. Not valid per-stratum digamma/trigamma.
CTRL_CORRELATED_IDENTIFIABILITY: MI(R;Z)>0.3 claimed but not computed from data. Regime varies within stratum, not identifiable from C=(URL,H_K=3).
claim_ceiling: No valid measurement obtained. Experiment is MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to multiple frozen gate failures (G0 analytic fabrication, G1 independent-noise p-value violation, G2 synthetic substrate misreported, positive control failure, perfect collinearity of 4 R representations). The producer's COMPLETE/FALSIFIES outcome is not licensed by the frozen decision_rule, which requires all gates to pass before primary test evaluation. The negative result (BC~0.01, gap<0.05, rel_sep<200) is consistent with estimator bias on a synthetic substrate with a blind pipeline, not evidence against C-WEB-DYNAMICS. Bounded to: synthetic 5-state FSM with single-button HTML prototypes at 1280x720, N=1200, plug-in Laplace PMI with negative bias, fabricated analytic validation, and collinear representations. No inference to genuine Web dynamics or correlated non-determinism is justified.
unresolved: Whether a genuine correlated non-determinism FSM with real SPA DOM at 1280x720 can produce BC>0.05 with valid gates remains untested. This experiment's synthetic substrate and pipeline failures prevent any conclusion.
The positive control failure mode: is the regime bias too weak, or is the estimator fundamentally unable to detect signal even when present? Requires debugging with stronger synthetic signal.

The analytic validation path: can true per-stratum digamma/trigamma via gammaln/polygamma be implemented without heuristic alignment to perm_mean? The current code has the call sites but misuses them.
The collinearity problem: can 4 genuinely independent DOM representations be constructed from a single FSM prototype? The current design ties all representations to the same (regime, variant) tuple.
The independent-noise bank p-value anomaly: why does p_bonf=0.008 when BC~0? This suggests the permutation null distribution is not centered at the observed value despite BC~0.

Whether the Director's PARK recommendation (if BC~0/rel_sep<200 at N=1000-1999) applies when the measurement is invalid. The frozen decision_rule says any gate failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not FALSIFIES.
